decisions.reason: As the modular continuation of an already proven trommel platform, it likely now has enough market validation and low incremental portfolio risk that keeping it remains the better option.

The stationary electric fine shredder is still a narrower niche, but its fit with tougher processing needs and resource-saving electrified solutions justifies retaining it unless demand clearly weakens.

The green-waste mobile grinder serves a distinct application segment and, having remained in the portfolio after the broader grinder line was dropped, appears valuable enough to keep while monitoring demand.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line looks like a committed complementary platform with credible industrial applications, so near-term withdrawal is relatively unlikely.
